# design-record-mention-allowlist.txt
# Every file in plugins/gaia/ that references "design-record" must appear here.
# Classification: writer | reader | prose | test | schema
# Format: <relative-path-from-plugins/gaia/>  <classification>  <reason>
#
# Adding a new file that references design-record without listing it here
# will fail the sole-writer mention-registry test. To fix:
#   1. Add a line below classifying the reference
#   2. Only "writer" classification may contain write constructs
scripts/design-record.sh          writer   sole-writer script
tests/design-record.bats          test     test suite
schemas/design-record.schema.json schema   JSON Schema definition
agents/_base-dev.md                prose    dev-agent guidance to read the record
knowledge/review-skill-template.md prose    review-skill boilerplate

skills/gaia-test-review/SKILL.md    reader   reads design state
